title: Fast convolution solvers using moment-matching
summary: We propose two easy-to-implement fast algorithms based on moment-matching to compute the nonlocal potential $\varphi(\textbf{x})=(U\ast ρ)(\textbf{x})$ on bounded domain, where the kernel $U$ is singular at the origin and the density $ρ$ is a fast-decaying smooth function. Each method requires merely minor modifications to commonly-used existing methods, i.e., the sine spectral/Fourier quadrature method, and achieves a much better convergence rate. The key lies in the introduction of a smooth auxiliary function $ρ_1$ whose moments match those of the density up to an integer order $m$.…
